{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out sentinel values for missing age
valid_ages = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

print(f"Mean age of customers (excluding -1 sentinels): {mean_age}")"}
